parameter.name: resumeSecret
parameter.description: Required. Key material, at least 16 characters, from the secure vault. Every session key is derived from it and the run id, which is what makes this stage reproducible and therefore resumable.

parameter.name: encryptionConfigKey
parameter.description: Fallback only. The key store normally arrives as configKey on the stage.

parameter.name: symmetricKeyAlgorithm
parameter.description: AES_256 (default), AES_192, AES_128, CAMELLIA_256, CAMELLIA_192, CAMELLIA_128, TWOFISH, CAST5, TRIPLE_DES, BLOWFISH, IDEA.

parameter.name: compressionAlgorithm
parameter.description: UNCOMPRESSED (default here, unlike pgpEncrypt). Deflate output is deterministic only for a given runtime, so ZLIB or ZIP pins the transfer to one JVM build for resume. Transfer data is usually compressed already.

parameter.name: armor
parameter.description: ASCII-armor the output. true or false (default).

parameter.name: integrityCheck
parameter.description: Add an integrity (MDC) packet. true (default) or false.

parameter.name: fileName
parameter.description: Optional file name embedded in the literal-data packet.
